# Load raw (non-style-controlled) text ratings
ds = load_dataset("lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset", "text", split="full")
Each arena is a separate subset, arenas with style control have an additional subset with a `_style_control` suffix. - `text`, `text_style_control`
`full`: All historically published leaderboards; `latest`: Only the most recently published leaderboards.

- config_name: text
  data_files:
  - split: latest
    path: text/latest-*
  - split: full
    path: text/full-*
- config_name: text_style_control
  data_files:
  - split: latest
    path: text_style_control/latest-*
  - split: full
    path: text_style_control/full-*
